silt.definition: n. mud or clay or small rocks deposited by a river or lake
silt.translation:
n. 淤泥
vt. 使淤塞
vi. 淤塞

silted.translation: v. （河流等）为淤泥淤塞( silt的过去式和过去分词 ); （使）淤塞

silthiane.translation: 硅硫烷(具有Si-S-Si 键的有机硅化合物)

siltier.definition:
comparative of silty
s. full of silt
siltier.translation: (silty 的比较级) a. 淤泥的, 塞满了淤泥的

silts.definition:
n mud or clay or small rocks deposited by a river or lake
v become chocked with silt
silts.translation: v. （河流等）为淤泥淤塞( silt的第三人称单数 ); （使）淤塞

siltstone.definition: n. a fine-grained sandstone of consolidated silt

siltstones.definition:
plural of siltstone
n. a fine-grained sandstone of consolidated silt

silty.translation: a. 淤泥的, 塞满了淤泥的
